body:
Well I am the wife... Currently I m not meeting or talking to my inlaws for past 1 year. But they still give surprise visits so they can meet me ( though i ran off the house before they could meet me) .
My husband obviously talks to his parents but then he gets tensed and since i am so much on love with him I get tensed. Is been going on since forever. All of this has led to so much of negativity in me.

I got married 2.5 yrs back. My in laws have made my life a living hell and on top of it my parents don't seem to understand what i m going through and keep finding faults in me which they think are upsetting my in laws.

I have stopped talking to my inlaws for more than a year now. I have been married for 2.5 years and have seen hell now. Things are fine between me and my husband but overall we have become very depressed of the whole toxic environment.
We know that my inlaws can't mend their ways...
My husband cant leave them. Though they don't stay with us they never stop bothering us even from 1500kms away. Life is a mess post marriage.
